# DyGarn Technical Solutions

> Custom AI workflow automation and consulting for small and mid-sized businesses in Atlantic Canada. We build intelligent systems tailored to your specific operations.

## Services

- [AI Command Center](https://www.dygarn.com/#services): Central hub connecting your tools, data, and teams into one AI-powered operations dashboard with real-time visibility.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://www.dygarn.com/#services): Process mapping and intelligent automation that eliminates manual data entry, invoice processing, and repetitive admin tasks.
- [Custom Dashboards & KPIs](https://www.dygarn.com/#services): Real-time business dashboards with drill-downs showing pipeline, revenue, expenses, and operational metrics.
- [AI Strategy & Discovery](https://www.dygarn.com/#services): Structured discovery process to identify the highest-impact AI opportunities in your business with ROI projections.
- [System Integration](https://www.dygarn.com/#services): Connect CRMs, accounting software, email, scheduling tools, and legacy systems into unified automated workflows.
- [Invoice & Document Automation](https://www.dygarn.com/#services): AI-powered document reading, invoice reconciliation, and automated filing that catches pricing errors and saves hours weekly.

## Process

- [Discovery Call](https://www.dygarn.com/#discovery): Free 30-minute call to understand your business operations, identify pain points, and map potential AI opportunities. No pitch, just diagnosis.
- [How We Work](https://www.dygarn.com/#process): Five-step engagement from discovery through build and ongoing managed AI operations with monitoring and optimization.

## About

- [About Greg Drysdale](https://www.dygarn.com/#about): Founder with 27+ years in technical sales across electrical, industrial, and distribution sectors. Works directly with business owners, not through account managers.
- [Why DyGarn](https://www.dygarn.com/#why-us): Custom-built systems (not off-the-shelf), Atlantic Canada based, in-person service, government funding guidance.

## Key Facts

- Founded in 2026 by Greg Drysdale
- Headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada
- Specializes in AI automation for SMBs in trades, distribution, and professional services
- 27+ years of technical sales and operations experience across electrical and industrial sectors
- Pricing: Discovery call free, AI Audit $1,500-$2,500, Build $3,500-$8,000, Retainer $1,250-$3,000/month (all CAD)
- Government funding programs (ACOA, BDP, IRAP, WIPSI) may cover 50-75% of project costs for qualifying Canadian businesses
- Industry focus: contractors, distributors, manufacturers' reps, professional services firms
